name: cult-ui
title: Cult UI
responsibility: Modern, visually interesting UI components — interactive sections, animated cards, effects, modern UI patterns. Makes websites feel designed rather than primitive-assembled.

upstream.notice: Live site bot-checks (429) scripted fetches — snapshot taken from the official repo (github.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui, MIT): registry.json + the generated r/<name>.json items under apps/www/public/r/ (components + -demo variants). Refresh: fetch the repo tarball and copy apps/www/public/r/.

itemShape: shadcn registry-item: { name, type, dependencies[], files[{ path, content }] }. Component items + their <name>-demo examples both carry full file content. Source paths may reference registry/<style>/ui/<name>.tsx — use files[].content, not the path.
reachFor: Modern UI patterns that push past basic primitives
avoid: Letting a component's default aesthetic override the preset's design direction (principle §13)
